services.name: Private Eco Tour
services.desc: A private 2-hour Island Safari into the Florida Bay backcountry aboard our 17′ RIB - dolphins, manatees, mangroves and more, for up to 6 guests. Family-owned in Key Largo since 1983, our private eco tour is a 2-hour exploratory charter aboard a nimble 17′ AB inflatable RIB that takes you deep into the Florida Bay backcountry - through hidden creeks, inlets, undisturbed islands and dense mangrove forests that bigger boats simply cannot reach. This is an "Island Safari Adventure" with a naturalist's eye. Your guide narrates the marine ecosystems you pass through along with the area's rich natural and pirate history. services.name: Snorkeling Excursions
services.desc: A private catamaran snorkeling charter on the calm, crystal-clear shallows of Florida Bay. Gear, floats and paddleboards included - no swimming skills needed. Family-owned in Key Largo since 1983, our Island Adventure Snorkeling Excursion is a fully private sail aboard the Carolina Moon - a 37′ × 22′ open catamaran sailboat, USCG certified for up to 24 passengers plus 2 crew. We sail to the protected Pelican Key area, a mangrove island and bird refuge inside the National Marine Sanctuary that borders Everglades National Park. Voted the #1 best sunset experience, this romantic sunset cruise gives you spectacular, unobstructed sunsets and a glowing afterglow over the water. services.desc: Grab your crew and take the whole catamaran. Bachelorette parties, birthdays, reunions and corporate days on the calm turquoise water of Florida Bay - for up to 24 guests. Family-owned in Key Largo since 1983, Caribbean Watersports lets you charter the Carolina Moon - a 37′ × 22′ open sailing catamaran, USCG certified for up to 24 passengers plus 2 crew - entirely for your group. It's the whole boat, your way: no strangers, no fixed schedule, just your people and the water.
